answer_1.quote: We conduct experiments on three commonsense-aware text generation tasks including story ending generation, abductive natural language generation, and explanation generation for sense making.
answer_1.outputs: story endings, explanatory hypotheses, and explanations

answer_2.quote: For automatic evaluation, we use metrics including BLEU-4, CIDEr, ROUGE-L and METEOR to evaluate the abductive NLG and the explanation generation tasks. We follow common practice in story generation and use BLEU-1/2 to evaluate the generated endings. We also adopt Distinct-n to measure the diversity of the generated endings.

answer_4.quote: We recruit three annotators to make a preference among win, tie and lose given the input context and two outputs generated by our model and a baseline respectively according to two criteria: fluency and reasonability.
answer_4.guideline: For fluency, we require the annotators to focus only on the grammatical correctness and readability of the generated results disregarding the input context. When evaluating reasonability, the annotators are required to assess whether the generated sentence is reasonable under the given context in each task.
